evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/db.cpp.
rationale: Prevents potential wallet database corruption and data loss during legacy-to-descriptor migration. On master, migration 'deletes the original database before writing the new one and asserts if anything fails after that', and preexisting journal files can cause SQLite to roll 'pages of an unrelated database into it' (PR description and commit e2e397edae).
